name of the mantra or power referred to
demonstrative pointing to the specified Kullikā
qualifies the person as spiritually inferior or unfit

items.question: What is the spiritual status of one who chants without knowing this Kullikā?
premises: Chanting is performed by a person.
This chanting occurs without knowing this Kullikā.
Such a person is declared to be the lowest.
items.inference: Therefore, chanting without knowledge of this Kullikā marks the practitioner as spiritually unfit or lowest.
uncertainties: The specific identity and function of Kullikā in this context is not fully specified in the verse.
items.plain_english: O beloved, whoever chants without knowing this Kullikā is the lowest.
